title: Prefer structured knowledge over pure vector RAG for Lexora
summary: After initial experiments, pure vector search missed important legal relationships (case → statute → amendment). Decided to invest in richer linking between entities.

title: Do not build full Slack integration in v1 of internal KB
summary: Slack has too much noise. For first version, focus on documents, decisions, people and projects. Slack can be added later if needed.

title: Use Gemini for generation tasks in client demos
summary: Company decision to standardise on Gemini for most generation and analysis tasks in client work, unless client has strong preference otherwise.

title: MediSync project stays in discovery until clinical advisor is onboarded
summary: Healthcare domain needs stronger domain expertise before architecture decisions. Waiting for part-time clinical advisor.
